pattern_name: LCU Process Scan & Connection
steps: Scan running processes using psutil for LeagueClientUx.exe or LeagueClient.exe
Read command-line arguments to extract app-port and remoting-auth-token
If access denied, locate process directory and read physical lockfile
Construct basic auth header using credentials and target 127.0.0.1 with port
Start background WebSocket for OnJsonApiEvent updates

pattern_name: Automated Account Sign-In
steps: Retrieve encrypted password_enc from accounts.json
Decrypt password using win32crypt.CryptUnprotectData
Locate local Riot Client port and token
Send PUT request to /rso-authenticator/v1/authentication with credentials
If response is multifactor, prompt the user; if success, launch League of Legends

pattern_name: Dynamic winrate scraping and caching
steps: Map current Queue ID to mode baseline dataset
Spawn thread using ThreadPoolExecutor to scrape Lolalytics page in background
If bs4 available, parse champion names and win rate cells, updating memory cache
Return scraped win rate if cached and timestamp < 30 minutes; otherwise return mode baseline

pattern_name: Unified Riot & League Client Detection
steps: Read RiotClientInstalls.json to resolve installation directories for Riot Client and League of Legends
Perform a single process list iteration to find PIDs and cmdline arguments for both clients
If cmdline arguments are not accessible, read the lockfile directly from the resolved install directories
Cache the results using a 2-second TTL to prevent performance overhead on multiple queries

pattern_name: Default Account Autoload Configuration
steps: Add default flag 'is_default' to accounts.json profile schema
Create set_default_account(idx) and get_default_account_index() API in AccountManager
Integrate default selection checkbox in accounts UI add/edit form
Check connection state at application startup; if disconnected and a default account exists, trigger client launch and login macros automatically after a 2-second delay

pattern_name: In-Memory BaseHTTPRequestHandler Testing
steps: Subclass BaseHTTPRequestHandler overriding rfile and wfile with io.BytesIO
Attach a mock server object containing app_instance and cache attributes
Set path, command (method), and headers appropriately
Invoke do_GET() or do_POST() and parse response_code and wfile JSON contents

pattern_name: Headless CustomTkinter & Tkinter Unit Testing
steps: Avoid instantiating ctk.CTk() top-level window in setUp() or unit test test cases
Patch sys.modules with MagicMock instances for 'customtkinter' and 'tkinter'
Pop any previously imported UI widget modules from sys.modules to ensure clean import against mocks
Instantiate widget classes against a MagicMock parent window and assert instantiation succeeds without Tcl/Tk initialization

pattern_name: Testing Inertial Scroll Animations Headlessly
steps: Mock `_parent_canvas` with `winfo_exists` returning `True` and `yview` returning a `(top, bottom)` tuple
Invoke `apply_smooth_scroll(mock_frame)` and extract the `<MouseWheel>` callback bound to the widget
Construct a mock event with `delta = -120` to simulate one mouse wheel notch down
Trigger the callback and assert that `_parent_canvas.yview_moveto` is called with the expected calculated target coordinate, and verify velocity decay math

pattern_name: LCU WAMP WebSocket Latency Telemetry & High-Churn Disk Cache Pruning
steps: Record high-resolution perf_counter timestamps on WAMP message receive and dispatch in LCUClient
Maintain a 200-sample rolling window of latency values and calculate min/max/avg latency in get_ws_telemetry()
Log a warning if dispatch latency exceeds 50.0 ms threshold
Scan CACHE_DIR with os.scandir(), preserving system metadata files
Sort files by modification time (mtime) and remove oldest items when max_files, max_bytes, or max_age_days limits are exceeded
Benchmark cleanup duration and verify sub-millisecond execution for disk health

pattern_name: LCU WAMP Event Throughput Export & Champ Select Roll Asset Prefetching
steps: Maintain rolling 10-second event timestamp window and startup time in LCUClient
Export rolling (throughput_eps) and overall (overall_throughput_eps) events per second in get_ws_telemetry()
Extract team and bench champion IDs during Champ Select roll phase in AutomationEngine._handle_champ_select()
Pass keys to AssetManager.preload_champion_icons() to resolve keys, check memory cache, and asynchronously pre-download icons

pattern_name: LCU Sleep/Wake Fast Reconnection & Adaptive Spectator Polling Rate Throttle
steps: Detect time gaps >15s in LCUClient.connect() to infer system sleep or hibernation events
Reset exponential backoff self._backoff = 1.0 and self._last_scan_time = 0.0 immediately upon sleep gap detection or explicit reset_sleep_wake_backoff() call
Emit lcu_sleep_wake_recovery event on central EventBus for subscriber notification
Track spectator mode start time self._spectate_start_time when phase == 'Spectating' in AutomationEngine
Dynamically scale long-polling sleep fallback between TICK_SLEEP_SPECTATING (15s) and TICK_SLEEP_SPECTATING_MAX (30s) based on spectate duration, drastically reducing CPU and network idle load

pattern_name: Structured API Health Endpoint & Priority Queue Asset Fetching
steps: Record server start_time = time.time() upon ThreadingHTTPServer startup in start_api_server()
Expose GET /healthz route returning JSON with status: healthy, uptime_seconds, lcu_connected, automation_running, phase, and timestamp
Replace AssetManager._download_queue with queue.PriorityQueue()
Pass priority-stamped tasks (priority, counter, task_func) so that background preloading (priority 10) gives precedence to direct UI interactive requests (priority 0-5)

pattern_name: Automated WebSocket Exponential Jitter Backoff & Disk Cache Auto-Pruning
steps: Track _ws_reconnect_backoff in LCUClient, resetting to 1.0s on successful connection
On WebSocket disconnect or error, compute sleep duration = min(_ws_reconnect_backoff * random.uniform(0.8, 1.2), 30.0)
Double _ws_reconnect_backoff after each failed attempt up to 30.0s max
In AssetManager.preload_champion_icons, call check_auto_prune_disk_cache() before queueing downloads
If total cache files > 350 or bytes > 35MB, execute clean_disk_cache with dynamic headroom limits

pattern_name: Automated Connection Drop Diagnostics, Event Loop Latency Telemetry & UI Theme RAM Footprint Optimization
steps: In LCUClient, record connection drop reasons, timestamps, and drop frequency using _record_connection_drop(reason)
Track event loop processing duration loop_dur_ms during WebSocket message dispatch and expose _event_loop_latency_ms in get_ws_telemetry()
Expose connection_drop_count, last_drop_reason, event_loop_latency_ms, and connection_uptime_s in telemetry metrics
In DesignTokens, implement _intern_tokens(obj) string interning for loaded token dictionaries, keys, and token path lookups
Implement optimize_theme_memory() and get_theme_memory_footprint() to clear stale LRU caches and report memory optimization status

pattern_name: Dynamic Network Adapter Reconnect Throttling & Pre-Serialized JSON Buffer Writing
steps: Track network drop timestamps in LCUClient within a 15-second sliding window (_network_drop_timestamps)
When notify_network_state_change() is invoked or 3+ drops occur within 15s, activate _network_throttle_active and set reconnect backoff floor to 5.0s
Reset _network_throttle_active upon successful WebSocket connection
In LeagueLoopAPIHandler, define static pre-serialized byte constants (_HEALTH_OK_BYTES, _QUEUE_MODES_BYTES) for static/high-frequency endpoints
Implement _send_json(data, status_code=200) helper method using compact separators (',', ':') and direct bytes writing to bypass string encoding overhead and minimize GC pressure

pattern_name: Adaptive HTTP Client Timeout & Champion Skin Preview Memory Optimization
steps: In LCUClient, record HTTP request latencies in sliding window sample array _http_latency_samples and histogram buckets _http_latency_buckets via _record_http_latency(latency_ms)
Calculate p95 latency from samples and compute adaptive timeout = max(1.5, min((p95_ms / 1000.0) * 3.0 + 0.5, 8.0)) in get_adaptive_http_timeout()
Pass get_adaptive_http_timeout() as the dynamic timeout argument to session.request()
In AssetManager, maintain skin_icons OrderedDict and max_skin_icons LRU cap limit (default 80)

Implement get_skin_icon(skin_id, size=(60, 60)), evict_skin_icon_memory(max_skin_count), and get_skin_icon_memory_stats() to isolate skin preview memory allocation from general champion icons and splash art

pattern_name: Automated HTTP 5xx Retry Jitter Backoff & Skin Splash Art LRU Eviction Metrics
steps: In LCUClient, wrap HTTP requests in a max_attempts retry loop (default 3 retries) inside request() method
When response status code is 5xx (500 <= status_code <= 599), record _http_5xx_count and _http_retry_count under _req_diag_lock
Calculate exponential jitter backoff retry delay: base_delay = 0.05 * (2 ** attempt) + random.uniform(0.01, 0.04) and sleep before next retry attempt
In AssetManager, initialize _splash_hits, _splash_misses, and _splash_evictions to track splash art LRU cache performance
Implement get_splash_lru_cache_metrics() returning splash_count, max_splash_count, hits, misses, evictions, hit_ratio, and legacy_splash_count
Update get_splash_art(), _download_and_cache_image(), evict_splash_art_memory(), and get_memory_summary_diagnostics() to maintain metrics and enforce LRU bounds

pattern_name: HTTP Response Status Code Distribution Telemetry & Champion Skin Icon Preview LRU Hit-Rate Benchmarking
steps: In LCUClient, initialize _http_status_codes dict, _http_2xx_count, _http_3xx_count, _http_4xx_count, _http_5xx_count, and _recent_http_errors under _req_diag_lock
Implement _record_http_status_code(status_code, method, endpoint) called on every successful HTTP response
Increment range counters (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx, 429) and append 4xx/5xx errors to sliding window _recent_http_errors buffer
Implement get_http_status_telemetry() and export status_code_distribution, http_2xx_count, http_3xx_count, http_4xx_count, http_5xx_count, and http_error_rate_pct in get_request_diagnostics()
In AssetManager, initialize _skin_icon_hits, _skin_icon_misses, and _skin_icon_evictions under _lock

Implement get_skin_icon_lru_cache_metrics() returning skin_icon_count, max_skin_icon_count, hits, misses, evictions, hit_ratio, and integrate skin_icon_lru_metrics into get_memory_summary_diagnostics()

pattern_name: Offline Request Retry Queue Telemetry & TTL Disk Cache Scan Optimization
steps: In LCUClient, initialize _offline_retry_success_count, _offline_retry_fail_count, and _offline_retry_dropped_count under _req_diag_lock
Increment _offline_retry_dropped_count when _offline_queue hits _offline_queue_max capacity (50)
Flush queue requests via _execute_offline_retry(method, endpoint, data) wrapper, recording success (2xx) vs failure outcomes
Implement get_offline_retry_telemetry() exporting queue length, executed count, success/fail/dropped counts, and execution_success_rate_pct

In AssetManager, implement TTL scan caching in get_disk_cache_stats(force_scan=False) using _cached_disk_stats, _disk_stats_scan_timestamp, and _disk_stats_cache_ttl_s = 3.0s to eliminate redundant disk I/O
Implement get_disk_cache_scan_telemetry() returning scan count, cache hits, avg scan latency, and TTL settings

pattern_name: WebSocket Subscription Dispatch Telemetry & Champion Data Search Index Lookup Performance
steps: In LCUClient, track _ws_dispatch_count, _ws_total_dispatched_callbacks, _ws_dispatch_total_latency_ms, and _ws_max_dispatch_latency_ms under _ws_telemetry_lock
Record dispatch metrics in _record_ws_dispatch_telemetry(event_name, callbacks_count, dispatch_latency_ms) after callback submission

Implement get_ws_dispatch_telemetry() returning active_subscription_filters, total_registered_listeners, dispatch_event_count, dispatched_callbacks_count, avg_dispatched_callbacks_per_event, avg_dispatch_latency_ms, and max_dispatch_latency_ms
In AssetManager, implement pre-normalized indexed search filtering in _build_champ_search_index() mapping cid, key, name, lower_key, lower_name, tags, and roles
Implement search_champions(query, role, tag, limit=20) and get_champ_search_telemetry() returning search count, total latency, average latency, and index size

pattern_name: WebSocket Payload Decompression Pool Recycling & Champion Fuzzy Search LRU Telemetry
steps: In LCUClient, maintain _ws_decomp_pool list, _ws_decomp_pool_max_size (50), _ws_decomp_recycle_hits, _ws_decomp_recycle_misses, and _ws_decomp_bytes_recycled under _ws_telemetry_lock
Implement _acquire_decomp_buffer(size=1024) to pop pre-allocated bytearray buffers from pool or allocate new bytearrays on pool miss
Implement _recycle_decomp_buffer(buf) to return buffers to pool if capacity permits, accumulating sys.getsizeof memory recycled
Implement get_ws_decomp_pool_telemetry() returning pool_size, decomp_recycle_hits, decomp_recycle_misses, decomp_recycle_hit_ratio, and decomp_pool_memory_kb
In AssetManager, maintain _champ_search_fuzzy_evictions counter under _lock and increment when _champ_search_fuzzy_cache.popitem(last=False) is invoked during LRU capacity trimming
Implement get_fuzzy_search_lru_cache_metrics() returning fuzzy_cache_size, fuzzy_cache_max_size, hits, misses, evictions, hit_ratio, and memory_kb, and integrate into get_memory_summary_diagnostics()
